findings.current: If what I just did was a gamble based on faith in my own skill, then you’re trying to make a deal with someone you can’t trust to begin with.
findings.defect: “What I just did” presents the Slaughter Saint’s gamble as an action already taken rather than a course he proposed.
findings.rationale: The Korean contrasts his contemplated gamble with Taekyung’s contemplated deal; neither is described here as completed.
findings.replacement: If the gamble I proposed earlier rests on confidence in my own skill, you’re trying to make a deal with someone you can’t trust in the first place.
findings.source: 조금 전의 내가 스스로의 실력을 믿고 도박을 하는 거라면, 너는 애당초 믿을 수 없는 대상을 상대로 거래를 하려 하고 있지.

findings.current: I’d assumed that even Jeok Cheongang wouldn’t be able to read the Blood Lord’s Sound Transmission—one that had grown even more advanced than during the Shaolin Bloodshed.
findings.defect: The draft makes the Sound Transmission itself the thing that advanced, rather than the Blood Lord.
findings.rationale: 진일보한 놈 describes the Blood Lord’s advancement; that advancement is why Taekyung doubts Jeok can intercept his transmission.
findings.replacement: I’d assumed that even Jeok Cheongang couldn’t read the Sound Transmission of someone who’d grown even stronger since the Shaolin Bloodshed.
findings.source: 소림혈사 때보다도 더욱 진일보한 놈의 전음을 읽어 내는 것은 적천강으로서도 무리라고 여겼고

findings.current: He said he’d give me one day. I had to leave the city alone, sever the sinews and meridians in all four of my limbs, and surrender.
findings.defect: The deadline is detached from the required surrender, leaving unclear that Taekyung has one day starting now to comply.
findings.rationale: 지금부터 하루의 말미를 줄 테니 sets both the starting point and the time allowed for the demanded actions.
findings.replacement: He said I had one day, starting now, to leave the city alone, sever the sinews and meridians in all four of my limbs myself, and surrender.
findings.source: 지금부터 하루의 말미를 줄 테니, 홀로 성을 빠져나와 스스로 사지 근맥을 끊고 투항하라고요.

findings.current:
The Yangtze River Channel League’s corporal punishment was no ordinary whipping.

The rod was made from solid birchwood, soaked thoroughly in water, and wielded by a Supreme Peak master responsible for enforcing the rules.
findings.defect: The implement is an oar, not a rod or whip, and the disciplinarian is a Peak master, not a Supreme Peak master.
findings.rationale: 노 specifies an oar, while 절정 specifies the Peak realm. Both details establish how severe even ten strokes would be.
findings.replacement:
The Yangtze River Channel League’s corporal punishment was no ordinary beating.

The strokes were delivered with an oar made of hard birchwood and soaked in water—by a Peak master in charge of discipline.
findings.source:
장강수로맹의 그것은 일반적인 태형이 아니다.

단단한 박달나무로 만들어진 노에 물을 흠뻑 묻혀, 계율을 담당하는 절정 고수가 집행하니까.

findings.current: The master didn’t use internal energy, but even ten strokes were enough to leave the flesh on your backside swollen and several bones broken. You’d be bedridden for a couple of months.
findings.defect: “Swollen” understates 짓무르고: the flesh is left raw.
findings.rationale: The source describes damaged flesh, not merely swelling.
findings.replacement: The master didn’t use internal energy, but even ten strokes were enough to leave your backside raw and break several bones. You’d be bedridden for a couple of months.
findings.source: 열 대만 맞아도 엉덩이 살이 짓무르고 뼈가 몇 군데 부러지는 건 기본이니 두어 달은 앓아누워야 한다.

findings.current: “Senior Brother, and those damn Elders, too. They didn’t follow you.”
findings.defect: The draft drops 대, which identifies the eldest Senior Brother rather than an unspecified senior disciple.
findings.rationale: The specified seniority matters because Mu Song is distinguishing the disciple who carried out Pa Ryun’s order from the others who resisted it.
findings.replacement: “Eldest Senior Brother—and those damn Elders, too. They weren’t following you.”
findings.source: 대사형도, 그리고 그 빌어먹을 장로들도. 스승님을 따른 것이 아닙니다.

summary: The draft changes a proposed gamble into a completed action and misstates the advancement of the Blood Lord’s martial prowess. The river scene also changes the punishment implement and the rank of the person administering it.
